newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-MOYA TO FACE DOSEDEL IN AMSTERDAM FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MOYA TO FACE DOSEDEL IN AMSTERDAM FINAL.

text.p: Top seed Carlos Moya of Spain cruised effortlessly into the final of the Amsterdam Open on Saturday and will pit his strength against unseeded Czech Slava Dosedel.
Moya, ranked tenth in the world, won 6-4 6-3 against fourth-seeded Magnus Norman of Sweden, who was well off his usual form.
The 29th-ranked Norman made a string of unforced errors and even though he broke Moya's serve early in the second set he could not press the advantage.
In the first semifinal, Dosedel beat unseeded Marcelo Filippini of Uruguay 7-6 (7-5) 6-2.
In the first set tie-break, Dosedel got off to a 6-2 lead then conceded three set points before taking the set.
